# A bill whose line is booked to income, applying a split on that same income
# account.
#
# The account test a bill's expense split relies on is satisfied — the bill's
# posting books `Income:Vendor Rebates USD` — and it must still be refused.
# The reason that allowance exists is that a cost is a cost whichever entry
# carries it, which says nothing about revenue.
#
# So the refusal must not offer the posting as a way out either: it would
# give back the very account the file had just given it.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal stating the income account, with the
# entry untouched.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
bill "BILL-REBATE-001"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-02-24
  entry:
    date: 2026-02-24
    description: "Rebate"
    account: "Income:Vendor Rebates USD"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-02-24
    due: 2026-03-24
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-REBATE-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-24
    amount: 100
    account: "Liabilities:Credit Card USD"
    txn_guid: "445566778899aabbccddeeff00112233"
    txn_split_guid: "5566778899aabbccddeeff0011223344"
